description: This file contains multiple shell functions related to upgrading and configuring a specific board platform, including image check, upgrade steps, and configuration copy.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Checks the board name and sets REQUIRE_IMAGE_METADATA=1 if it matches specific hardware.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines whether the current board supports sysupgrade based on its name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process on supported hardware, writing an image to a device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to the device's partition during upgrade.
